Check each requirement for AVF Linux on this device and app.
Storage sharing uses APIs separate from basic VM execution. This inspection checks API access without creating files or VMs. Satisfied does not certify a successful shared mount.
Custom Image API access and compatibility
TERM AVF platform driver presence and compatibility
The device does not advertise the AVF system feature. An AVF-capable product system is required.

This app lacks the system permission. A product configuration permitting platform-signed or privileged access is required; a normal permission dialog cannot grant it. API support remains a separate check.
Access or compatibility was not checked because earlier requirements or API checks were not satisfied. Address those items and check again.

An incompatible device API ABI or Android hidden API restrictions may cause this error. The error alone cannot distinguish them. Check the actual target platform API and hidden API policy; the two VM permissions alone do not authorize hidden API access.
Platform API access was denied. Check actual grants and the product hidden API policy. Access denial alone does not establish lack of API support.
An inspection error prevented checking this condition. Review the error below and check again.
No VirtualMachineManager service was returned. Check device AVF services and product configuration.
The TERM AVF platform driver was not found in this app. Use a TERM build that includes it.
Satisfied describes inspected prerequisites and API signatures, and does not certify a successful VM boot. This inspection does not create or run a VM, install an image, or change an existing VM.

Composition bar: Unknown. Requires a positive PSS total and measurements for all components.
Component values exceed PSS, so a stacked bar cannot be displayed.
Gray segment: %1$s difference between PSS and displayed component values

App totals sum only Android UI and :vmhost PSS. If either process cannot be measured, the total is unknown. Areas follow Android summary categories and are not added to calculate PSS. Process sample times may differ. Shell and guest memory are excluded from app totals.
Measure the selected session shell and readable descendant process memory.
RSS is an estimate that may count shared pages twice or omit detached daemons. AVF sessions, exited sessions and restricted environments show unknown. RSS is not added to app PSS.
